description: Executable baseline coverage for every tracked or nonignored new JS/MJS, JSON and WGSL file. Scoped existing checks and review obligations are separate; baseline file coverage is not full semantic-rule coverage.

rules.limits: Every tracked or nonignored new .js/.mjs file; parser syntax only, not module execution or type correctness.
Exact legacy .mjs paths retained; no evidence rewrite required.
Every .json file; tsconfig*.json uses its declared JSONC dialect. Domain semantics require the owning schema.
Decoded key identity, not textual similarity.
Overflow must not silently create Infinity.

rules.rule: Declarations, logging, geometry and compute boundary
rules.limits: src/demo only. AST/regex numeric candidates are heuristics, not proof that arbitrary tensor work is absent.
Only roots listed in tsconfig.source-unused.json; noUnusedParameters is disabled.
Production source owners. Semantic equivalence and whether an abstraction is worthwhile require review.
Declared surfaces; requires behavior tests for new execution paths.
Static surface checks plus focused integration test, not proof of every browser environment.
Schema contract test; experimental fairness, representative workloads and measured speed require review and evidence.
Review user-facing authored text against approved symbols; data, tokenizer fixtures and quoted evidence may contain emoji. No blanket Unicode ban.
Review all normative prose not explicitly mechanically covered: semantic duplication, cleanup, compatibility, correctness and performance are not established by lexical checks.
Declared functions; builtins are not renamed.
Detects member access to _pad fields; ABI migrations require synchronized wrappers and numerical tests.
Full shader files only; .wgslinc inherits its enclosing shader directives.
Numeric literal annotations; not expression evaluation, layout proof or bounds checking.

legacyMjs.reason: Frozen content-addressed host module referenced by three Program Bundles and their artifact-set identities; preserve the recorded bundle payload/path.
legacyMjs.removalCondition: Remove when these example bundles are deliberately regenerated and requalified, not by rewriting preserved identities for style.

legacyMjs.reason: Archived driver bytes and filename are bound into the frozen weight-representation replay contract and driver identity set. Renaming requires rewriting historical replay metadata or adding a compatibility alias.
legacyMjs.removalCondition: Remove when this archived replay package is deliberately retired or superseded with preserved provenance; do not broaden the exception.
